evidence.detail: GBModData_DisabilityWeights.csv stores regional male and female healthy disability weights by age bin.

Live disability.healthy has 504 rows, matching the transformed GBModData source shape.

data_registry.human_label: Healthy population disability weights by GBD region, sex and age bin

data_registry.transformation_notes: The source CSV has 21 GBD/Spectrum regions with male and female disability weights for 12 age bins. The helper flattens the wide CSV to region, sex, age_bin and value; the live table has 504 rows, matching 21 regions x 2 sexes x 12 age bins.

data_registry.citation: WHO. Technical briefing for Appendix 3 of the Global Action Plan for Non-Communicable Diseases: Tobacco control interventions. 28 November 2022.

evidence.detail: RiskFactorData.xls contains TabTax and AlcTax sheets.
NCUtil applies tax effects through demand elasticity and recorded-consumption share.
WHO tobacco Appendix 3 technical brief documents OneHealth use, GHO prevalence, GBD 2019 epidemiology and tobacco tax scenario assumptions.

data_registry.human_label: Alcohol and tobacco tax defaults
data_registry.retrieval_method: Local Spectrum NC risk-factor workbook tax sheets transformed into risk_factor_tax tables.
data_registry.transformation_notes: Covers tobacco, beer, wine and spirits tax input tables. Spectrum reads country-specific tax, unrecorded-consumption and elasticity values, with fallback defaults in code. WHO Appendix 3 tobacco documentation supports the 25 percent retail-price-increase scenario and approximately -0.5 elasticity family used in tobacco intervention modelling.

data_registry.human_label: Tobacco intervention effect-size and tax assumptions
data_registry.retrieval_method: Registered from shared model constants and Spectrum risk-factor workbook documentation.
data_registry.source_name: WHO Appendix 3 tobacco technical assumptions via Spectrum/OneHealth
data_registry.source_version: WHO technical brief 2022; Spectrum RiskFactorData workbook
data_registry.transformation_notes: This is the best documented upstream family: WHO Appendix 3 technical briefing says OneHealth was used for impact estimation, with WHO GHO tobacco prevalence, IHME GBD 2019 epidemiology and disability weights, and a tobacco tax scenario based on a 25 percent retail price increase.
